digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler backend port and transport layer
propositions: DC transport raises jira.exceptions.JIRAError but core modules catch only urllib.error.HTTPError, causing exceptions to escape instead of being handled softly
outbound_differ._safe_get_issue fails to classify remotely-deleted issues (404) when raised by DC transport, breaking deletion detection
dispatch_apply_phases._update_one_apply_reporter fails to degrade on DC 4xx errors due to exception type mismatch
Backend port has no declared exception contract, forcing core modules to depend on transport-specific exception types
BackendHTTPError must subclass urllib.error.HTTPError and preserve HTTP status codes so existing catch clauses and code attribute access work without modification to core modules
